title: Simplifying Bias Correction for Selective Sampling: A Unified Distribution-Free Approach to Handling Endogenously Selected Samples
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Methods paper on bias correction for outcome-dependent (endogenously selected) samples using a semiparametric odds-ratio model; simulation studies plus a cross-sectional application (store visits on customer demographics).
design_notes: Rcode.R / pfunc.R: fitsor() calls Outsample.exe (Fortran) for the semiparametric odds-ratio estimator; simulations and the visits.csv application (totalvisit on incomec, distc, agec, marriedc, kidsc). Stata portion for comparison models. No panel, no treatment timing.
data_files_note: readme.txt: variables standardized and 'Data are also masked to protect original data values.'
software_notes: R 3.6.3 calling a Fortran executable; a Stata portion (Stata 14).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
